newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco withdraws 825 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco withdraws 825 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 825 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Wednesday.

The bank received bids totalling 4.111 billion dirhams and allocated 2.975 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 3.800 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 72.36 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on May 28.
